query: Obsidian complaints OR frustrating OR broken

results.title: Multiple Issues with Obsidian
results.content: I can't copy and paste an image. I can't use a to-do list plugin correctly. The last couple of months have been so frustrating that I'm considering migrating to notion.

results.title: Obsidian is Frustrating Me SO Much
results.content: Obsidian is a great note taking tool, but it's frustrating me to no end right now. I'm honestly wondering if it's time to move back to Notion.

results.title: Obsidian Review: Not Just a Planning Tool?
results.content: Obsidian's in-app tutorial leaves a lot to be desired. Certain features are only available with third-party plugins.

results.title: I Think I've Grown Tired of Obsidian
results.content: Maps of content were a revelation but once they start to grow they become unwieldy. Obsidian just seems to either fight me too much all the time.

results.title: WTF is wrong with Obsidian?
results.content: There is something wrong with the communication between the designers and the coders in Obsidian.
